statement: Dolphin ControllerInterface invalidates its downstream extension ID only on changed base status extension bit or changed embedded MotionPlus downstream-connected bit. It reads A400FA/6 for mapped MP and A400F6/4 only while active in passthrough with downstream connected and downstream ID still unknown. With no edge after a pre-activation Nunchuk ID was cached, F6 is skipped; a toggle can make F6 reachable but may allow an earlier ordinary FA read to repopulate the ID. F6 mirror is a conditional consumer gate.
